+"""RoboTwin pick_diverse_bottles episode controller (eai-standard/2.1)."""

+# The local +x approach axis is rotated to point down; the local finger axis
+# remains horizontal along world x so each arm can pinch the bottle body.
+DOWN_Q = np.array([0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5], dtype=np.float32)  # w, x, y, z
+TARGETS = {
+    "left": {"xyz": (-0.117, 0.094), "grasp_tcp_z": 0.840},
+    "right": {"xyz": (0.144, 0.040), "grasp_tcp_z": 0.850},
+}
+
+
+def make_pose(x, y, tcp_z, grip):
+    # EE is 0.12 m behind the TCP, opposite the downward approach direction.
+    return np.array([x, y, tcp_z + 0.120, *DOWN_Q, grip], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def read_now(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    return obs, np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def run_phase(robot, phase):
+    arm, stage = phase.rsplit("_", 1)
+    other = "right" if arm == "left" else "left"
+    cfg = TARGETS[arm]
+    obs, now = read_now(robot)
+
+    if stage == "pregrasp":
+        active = make_pose(*cfg["xyz"], 1.120, 1.0)
+    elif stage == "grasp":
+        active = make_pose(*cfg["xyz"], cfg["grasp_tcp_z"], 1.0)
+    elif stage == "close":
+        start = 14 if arm == "left" else 21
+        active = now[start:start + 7].copy()
+        active = np.r_[active[:6], 0.0]
+    elif stage == "lift":
+        active = make_pose(*cfg["xyz"], 1.100, 0.0)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown phase {phase}")
+
+    other_start = 14 if other == "left" else 21
+    held = now[other_start:other_start + 7].copy()
+    held_grip = float(now[28 if other == "left" else 29])
+    held = np.r_[held, held_grip]
+    row = np.r_[active, held] if arm == "left" else np.r_[held, active]
+
+    result = robot.submit(
+        "ee_pose", row, video="mp4", video_fps=10,
+        cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"),
+        note=f"pick_diverse_bottles:{phase}",
